findings.explanation: You are subjected to a conditional 'pay-when-paid' term, meaning your payment depends on an indefinite or client-controlled event rather than your own work.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable within 30 days after receipt of the invoice.

findings.quoted_text: Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.
findings.explanation: Your liability is completely uncapped while the client's liability is limited, exposing you to unlimited financial risk.
findings.suggested_change: Each party's aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable by the Client under this Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: Payment period: 15 days after Client is paid by its customer
findings.explanation: Your payment is conditioned on the Client getting paid by someone else, which creates a high risk of delayed or missing income if their customer pays late or not at all.
findings.suggested_change: Payment shall be made within 15 days of the invoice date.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a few adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause "Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.", I would like to avoid a pay-when-paid term, and propose changing it to: "Invoices are payable within 30 days after receipt of the invoice.". - Regarding the clause "Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.", my liability is currently uncapped, and I propose changing it to: "Each party's aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable by the Client under this Agreement.". - Regarding the clause "Payment period: 15 days after Client is paid by its customer", this creates delays tied to third parties, and I propose changing it to: "Payment shall be made within 15 days of the invoice date.". Please let me know if these updates work for you so we can finalize the paperwork. Best regards
